triggers.desc: `HH:mm` input with a time picker (24h); validated by AJV as the picker stores it (seconds and timezone optional).

….desc: Every option is passed as a prop to [QInput](https://quasar.dev/vue-components/input#qinput-api).

data.desc: A string, `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`. Read-only, the picker icon is hidden.
